other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of the State.
Must belong to the State Religious Minority Community.
Must not have availed benefits under any other KMDCL scheme (excluding the Arivu Scheme) in the last 5 years.
No family member should be an employee of State/Central/Government Public Sector Units.
Applicant shall not be a loan defaulter in KMDC.
benefits_summary: A loan of ₹50,000 at 4% interest for 36 installments, along with training in artistic and technical skills for religious minority community entrepreneurs.
